Wanted_Level.text:
Main article: Wanted Level in GTA VI
Compared to previous Grand Theft Auto titles, The Wanted Level system is due to be entirely overhauled, with addtional mechanics added to increase the challenge of gaining and losing police attention. Multiple states of Wanted Level will allow players to occassionally more easily avoid police observation, while the new "Heat Indicator" mechanic will make losing police attention more dynamic and require more preplanning.

Relationship_Status.text:
Main article: Relationship Status
Grand Theft Auto VI's story and gameplay are due to focus on the romantic interactions between its protagionists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Similar to girlfriend and friendship interactions in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas and Grand Theft Auto IV, the player will be able to control the relationship between Jason and Lucia by going on dates and performing tasks together, ultimately deciding whether or not the pair are a true couple or purely partners in crime.

Criminal_Profile.text:
Main article: Criminal Profile
The new Criminal Profile status system affects how Jason and Lucia are individually treated throughout the storyline and game world, depending on the severity and professionalism of their criminal actions.
